newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT launches new integrated imports service.
newsitem.headline: TNT launches new integrated imports service.

text.p: TNT Worldwide Express said it now accepts door-to-door imports from 50 countries to Germany.
The integrator's new import service covers documents, parcels and freight shipments without weight or volume limits, a company statement said.
Shipments are picked up at agreed times, cleared for import, transported, cleared through customs and delivered direct, it added.
Customers can track and trace their shipments through TNT's Web Tracker service on its Internet home page.
Deutschmark import prices are equivalent to export rates regardless of currency fluctuations and a TNT single account executive is responsible for exports and imports.
